features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, providing a smooth normalized score that helps the linear SVM capture interaction effects between these two continuous descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a non-linear relationship into a linear feature, improving the margin separation for the SVM.

features.name: v8_v30_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of V8 and V30, creating an approximate linear projection that scales these features into a unified severity measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a pre-calculated linear combination that stabilizes weight assignment in the downstream model.

features.name: v12_abs_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of V12 from its mean, offering a continuous magnitude measure that allows the linear model to penalize extreme variations symmetrically.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows a linear model to capture symmetric non-linear effects (V-shape) around the mean.

features.name: v15_v39_interaction
features.description: Scaled product of V15 and V39, explicitly providing a multiplicative interaction term to the linear SVM without requiring a non-linear kernel.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a cross-feature interaction directly to the linear solver, expanding its representational capacity.

features.name: v31_log_scaled
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of V31 to compress its long tail, resulting in a smoother distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the influence of extreme outliers, improving the stability and robustness of linear SVM weights.

features.name: v16_v41_sum
features.description: Sum of integer features V16 and V41, acting as a combined frequency or count measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clear, monotonic linear gradient for the decision boundary by aggregating related count features.

features.name: v3_v5_v7_density
features.description: Average of V3, V5, and V7, creating a stable, low-variance composite feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces noise by averaging correlated structural counts, leading to a more robust linear coefficient.

features.name: v13_v14_diff
features.description: Difference between V13 and V14, directly supplying the linear SVM with a relative contrast measure between these two properties.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights the relative dominance of one feature over another, which is highly effective for linear margin optimization.

features.name: v27_v28_norm
features.description: Euclidean norm of V27 and V28, providing a continuous magnitude feature that captures the combined intensity of these variables.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the joint scale of two features in a single continuous dimension, useful for distance-based margins.

features.name: v36_v37_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V36 to V37, offering a normalized relative scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the linear model separate instances based on proportional differences rather than absolute values.

features.name: molecular_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of molecular complexity based on structural descriptors, providing a high-level continuous feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearly separates complex from simple structures using domain-informed logic that a linear model cannot easily infer.

features.name: hydrophobicity_estimate
features.description: Semantic estimation of hydrophobicity, offering a domain-informed continuous score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aligns well with linear decision boundaries in chemical spaces by providing a synthesized physical property estimate.
